02 / The room

A shelf for
everything.

Old telephones, brass scales, copper kettles and biscuit tins. The shelves are as much a part of this café as the timber counter and exposed brick.

Look around while your coffee is being made. There’s a small detail waiting in almost every corner.

Find your spot. 8 West Parade, West Ryde. Check the café’s latest posts for opening hours and what’s happening.

03 / Coffee, with a twist

Two drinks to ask about.

Featured in the café’s social posts. Ask the team what’s being poured today.

  • Once Upon a Latte

    Condensed milk and an espresso ice cube, for a sweet coffee that stays rich as the ice melts.

  • Cloud Brew

    Cold brew finished with vanilla foam: creamy on top, bold underneath.

For today’s selection and prices, check with the café ↗
